Web opens the back door, and directs <@!363458590461132800> on where to set them.

He makes it no secret that the cloak’s warmth is one of his favorite things, full stop. After fully basking in it, he quietly asks,
“I don’t — it’s okay if you don’t want to bring it up again, but is there anything you do that distracts you? From the voices? We can do it more often, and together.”
Baeshra sets the body down gently as if the cadaver was just someone sleeping.
Web does the same. Little preparation is required, so long as no one disturbs them. Web finally changes out of their fancy outer clothes, then turns to Baeshra. "You lead the way."

Also, for something happier:
Just as Baeshra has been motivated by her relationship to speak more formally, Web has begun to adopt a few of Baeshra's speaking patterns somewhat.
“I love you,” he elects to say in Wynne’s voice, carefully turning his head to poke their cheek with his beak in affection.
"Baeshra think so too." She looks out to the stars.  "Life join.. mary.. ritual like today. Like that in Web home?"
They smile softly, eyes shining. “We really should sleep.”
“It’s always a shame that we sleep when the stars are out,” he comments idly, snuggling up and closing his eyes.
Web tilts their head and Waves their hand. "Some the same. Some different. Baeshra home simpler, you said?"
“Unfortunately, the stars always come out when I’m tired.” They tease gently, closing their eyes.
“That’s fine. They’ll wait and come out again,” he reassures, and drifts off.
